referenceBlocks: Language school students
Here at 'English for All' Language School there are students from lots
of different countries. Let’s talk to four of them!
MOHAMMED:
Hi! I’m from Jordan. I love technology and English. I want to be a
businessman, so English is important for me. I can speak English
and Arabic, but I can’t speak Spanish.
TERESA:
Hello. I come from Argentina in South America. I can play the piano and I
can sing. I want to be an actor. I think it’s good to study English – lots
of songs are in English and I can sing them well.
NING:
Hello everyone. I'm from China. I can remember a lot of words in English,
but sometimes I can’t remember people’s names in my class! I can’t
play football – I don’t like sports, but I can dance salsa. I love it!
ADAM:
Hi. I’m Nigerian. I am really good at sports. I can throw, catch and run ten
kilometres. I also love technology. I use apps to make video calls on
my phone every day – I call my parents.
My favourite place
I’m Ginny. I live in a big city, but my favourite place is a small town two hours
from my house. It’s called Aubrey and my grandparents live there. I
visit them about once a month and we do lots of things together. For
example, there are two nice parks in the town. We often walk there in
the afternoons.
My grandmother likes to cook, but my grandfather enjoys restaurants.
There is a great Italian restaurant in Aubrey – we usually go there on Friday
evenings. My grandfather also likes Japanese food.
It's easy to live in Aubrey because there are many good places in the town.
There is a big supermarket, two shopping centres, a post office and
a bank. There aren’t any swimming pools, but that’s OK because you can
swim in the river!
